items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: You see how it was, you take, Urico, I mean Excelsior was in front.

ctx.x: Well we opened up, we opened up right at the graveyard you see. I believe we was behind, wasn't we? We was behind. We was the last man. And then we opened up, let them go in the graveyard.
You see how it was, you take, Urico, I mean Excelsior was in front.
